mapper.select: SELECT HOSPITAL_ID AS hospitalId, PLACE_ID AS placeId, NAME AS name, ADDRESS AS address, LAT AS lat, LON AS lon FROM HOSPITAL WHERE PLACE_ID = #{placeId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_HOSPITAL.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO HOSPITAL (HOSPITAL_ID, PLACE_ID, NAME, ADDRESS, LAT, LON) VALUES (#{hospitalId}, #{placeId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{lat}, #{lon})
INSERT INTO HOSPITAL_SAVE (HOSPITAL_SAVE_ID, HOSPITAL_ID, USER_ID) VALUES (SEQ_HOSPITAL_SAVE.NEXTVAL, #{hospitalId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT H.HOSPITAL_ID AS hospitalId, H.PLACE_ID AS placeId, H.NAME AS name, H.ADDRESS AS address, H.LAT AS lat, H.LON AS lon FROM HOSPITAL_SAVE HS JOIN HOSPITAL H ON HS.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID WHERE HS.USER_ID = #{userId}
